history.title: Our History
history.description: Founded on February 23, 1994, in Belém, Pará, Camila Navegação e Transportes has built its history as a vital link in waterway connections across the Amazon. Over more than three decades, the company has expanded into cargo, vehicle, and passenger transport, operating strategic routes on Pará's rivers, including crossings between Santarém and Santana do Tapará, Cametá and Carapajó, and Baião. With an ongoing focus on operational efficiency and regional development, the company's work has been recognized by regulatory bodies and the Brazilian Navy, which has honored it with the Amigo da Marinha medal. Tradition, commitment, and responsibility sail side by side in the making of our history.

activities.ferry: Vehicles and passengers crossing via Ferryboats and Barges.

fleet.title: Our Fleet
fleet.description: Camila Navegação operates a fleet of modern and safe vessels, ensuring comfort and security for passengers during river crossings across the Amazon region.

items.name: Ferryboats
items.description: Our fleet includes ferryboats equipped to transport both passengers and vehicles safely and comfortably. We are on the frontline connecting cities and regions across Amazonian rivers with speed, safety, and reliability.

items.name: Barges
items.description: We operate barges suited for both short crossings and long-distance routes. They are engineered to transport vehicles and passengers safely, ensuring a smooth and efficient journey.

items.name: Pusher Tugs
items.description: Responsible for pushing barges and other vessels, ensuring operational safety and efficiency during river transit. Our pusher tugs are equipped with high-performance technology to support safe river transport.

items.name: Hospital Ships
items.description: We support social initiatives by transporting patients and healthcare professionals to remote areas in the Amazon. Our hospital vessels are equipped to provide safe and reliable medical support.
